description: EastGate Strata Workflow Catalogue — named automation definitions (S1+S2)

workflows.name: Quarterly Levy Run
workflows.description: Generates levy notices and sends emails to all owners at the start of each quarter.
workflows.trigger_description: 1st day of Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec, 06:00 AEST
workflows.jurisdiction_notes: NSW: must include hardship statement. ACT: standard notice.
workflows.failure_mode: Retry once; notify strata_manager if second failure

workflows.name: Arrears Notice — Tier 1 (14 days overdue)
workflows.description: Sends formal arrears notice when levy payment is 14+ days overdue.
workflows.trigger_description: Weekly Sunday — levy_payments overdue >= 14 days
workflows.jurisdiction_notes: UTM Act s.83 (ACT) — formal notice required before interest accrues at statutory rate
workflows.failure_mode: Flag in arrears board; notify strata_manager

workflows.name: Work Request SLA Breach Alert
workflows.description: Marks workflow_requests as sla_breached when sla_due_at has passed. Notifies assigned strata manager.
workflows.trigger_description: Every 15 minutes — workflow_requests where status not closed and sla_due_at < now
workflows.failure_mode: Log scheduler failure; alert via separate monitoring

workflows.name: AGM Notice Dispatch
workflows.description: Strata manager triggers with minimum statutory notice period.
workflows.trigger_description: Strata manager triggers with min 14 days notice (UTM Act, ACT) / 21 days (NSW SSMA)
workflows.jurisdiction_notes: ACT: 14 days. NSW: 21 days. Platform enforces minimum notice period at creation.
workflows.failure_mode: Block notice creation if < minimum days; surface error to strata_manager

workflows.name: Proposal Voting Auto-Close
workflows.description: Automatically closes proposals when voting_closes_at has passed. Records pass/fail outcome based on votes.
workflows.trigger_description: Every 30 minutes — proposals where voting_closes_at < now and status = open
workflows.failure_mode: Log; proposal remains open; next run corrects

workflows.name: Compliance Deadline Reminder
workflows.description: Marks compliance_items as overdue when due_date has passed. Weekly Monday 08:00 AEST.
workflows.trigger_description: Every Monday 08:00 — check compliance_items due within 30/14/7 days
workflows.failure_mode: Log and retry next run

workflows.name: Preventive Maintenance Due Notification
workflows.description: Notifies when PPM schedule items are due. Daily 07:00 AEST.
workflows.trigger_description: Daily 07:00 — check ppm_schedules with due_date within threshold
workflows.failure_mode: Log and retry

workflows.name: Lease Expiry Alert
workflows.description: Sends notifications when lease agreements are approaching expiry. Daily 07:00 AEST.
workflows.trigger_description: Daily 07:00 — leases expiring in 90/60/30/14 days
workflows.failure_mode: Log and retry

workflows.name: Building Health Score Recompute
workflows.description: Recomputes intelligence/analytics summary for all active buildings. Daily 02:00 AEST.
workflows.trigger_description: Daily 02:00 AEST — per building (all active buildings)
workflows.failure_mode: Stale data shown with computed_at timestamp; alert strata_manager

workflows.name: BI Analytics ETL Refresh
workflows.description: Refreshes analytics.fact_* (Postgres BI schema) from live operational data for all active buildings. Daily 02:15 AEST.
workflows.trigger_description: Daily 02:15 AEST — per building (all non-archived buildings)
workflows.failure_mode: BI Analytics/Financial Intelligence panels keep serving the previous day's analytics.fact_* rows (or fall back to live MongoDB where implemented); alert super_admin on repeated failure

workflows.name: Guest Account Expiry
workflows.description: Deactivates guest accounts whose stay end_date has passed. Daily 03:00 AEST.
workflows.trigger_description: Daily 03:00 AEST — deactivate expired guest accounts
workflows.failure_mode: Log and retry

workflows.name: Parcel Arrival Notification
workflows.description: Notifies residents when a parcel is logged at reception. Event-triggered.
workflows.trigger_description: parcels.insert — status = received
workflows.failure_mode: Log; resident notified on next manual check

workflows.name: Comms Intake Classification
workflows.description: Classifies inbound portal messages and emails into workflow categories. Sets SLA clock. Sends acknowledgement.
workflows.trigger_description: request.submitted — portal form or inbound email
workflows.failure_mode: Log error; request queued as general_enquiry for manual triage

workflows.name: Levy Arrears Notifier
workflows.description: Sends automated levy arrears reminders to owners with outstanding balances. Configurable schedule.
workflows.trigger_description: Weekly Sunday — owners with balance_owing > 0
workflows.failure_mode: Log and retry next week

workflows.name: NSW Strata Hub Annual Report Reminder
workflows.description: Sends reminders at 60/30/7 days before NSW Strata Hub annual report deadline.
workflows.trigger_description: agm.status = completed AND jurisdiction = NSW — triggers 3-month countdown
workflows.jurisdiction_notes: NSW only: annual report due within 3 months of AGM. Penalty for non-compliance.
workflows.failure_mode: Escalate to chairman if not completed 7 days before deadline

workflows.name: Insurance Renewal Reminder
workflows.description: Sends reminders when insurance policies are expiring within 90/60/30 days.
workflows.trigger_description: Weekly Monday — insurance_policies expiring within 90/60/30 days
workflows.failure_mode: Log and retry next week

workflows.name: Weekly Notification Digest
workflows.description: Sends a weekly summary digest email to residents with unread notifications. Sunday 18:00 AEST.
workflows.trigger_description: Sunday 18:00 AEST — residents with unread notifications
workflows.failure_mode: Log and retry next week

workflows.name: Suburb Radar Digest
workflows.description: Sunday evening local intelligence digest: property sales, planning applications, safety events.
workflows.trigger_description: Sunday 17:00 AEST — local property and planning intelligence
workflows.failure_mode: Log and skip week

workflows.name: Morning Card Generator
workflows.description: Generates personalised morning summary card for each resident dashboard. Daily 06:00 AEST.
workflows.trigger_description: Daily 06:00 AEST — per resident
workflows.failure_mode: Skip day; stale card shown with generated_at timestamp

workflows.name: Workflow Heartbeat Monitor
workflows.description: Checks that scheduled workflows are running within expected intervals. Flags stale workflows.
workflows.trigger_description: Every 10 minutes — checks last run time against expected interval for all scheduled workflows
workflows.failure_mode: Log scheduler failure; workflows flagged stale on dashboard
